title: Understanding Overfitting
text: Overfitting occurs when a model learns the training data too well, capturing noise along with the underlying pattern. This results in poor performance on new, unseen data.

title: What is Model Variance?
text: Model variance refers to the variability of model predictions for different training data sets. High variance models are sensitive to the specific data they are trained on.

title: Effect of Decreasing Lambda
text: In ridge regression, decreasing the regularization parameter lambda (λ) reduces the penalty on large coefficients, potentially increasing model variance.

title: Impact of Lambda on Variance
text: If Parth decreases λ, what happens to the model variance?

title: Strategies to Reduce Variance
text: To reduce model variance, consider increasing λ, using more data, or simplifying the model.
